heading: From plot to plate — in four steps.
intro: No farming experience needed. We handle everything from soil to your door.

steps.title: Choose your plot
steps.description: Pick your plot size, preferred region, and the crops you want. We'll match you with available land near Yerevan.

steps.title: A farmer takes care of it
steps.description: A real local farmer tends your plot — planting, watering, harvesting. You know their name and their land.

steps.title: Track everything on your dashboard
steps.description: See photos of your plot, growth stages, weather updates, and when your next harvest is expected.

steps.title: Receive weekly deliveries
steps.description: As your crops ripen, they're harvested and delivered to your door — 1–2 kg at a time, fresh and seasonal.
